questions.question: At which ground did Bronwyn Sumption record their career-best bowling figures (2-27, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Susan Benade) and #2 (Kirstie Thomson) six-hitters (T20) in the 21/22 season?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade: 5 — Kirstie Thomson: 4 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: At which ground did Kei record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 174, against Heat on 2018/02/10.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Heat?
"Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).

questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — highest total of 420, against Boland on 2019/02/02.
